panels.description: Alex stands before the bookcase; one narrow gap is empty behind technical manuals. Leave upper shelf space.
The looping equation engraved on Adrian's watch caseback fills the panel. Leave upper space.
Alex places the notebook in the gap. The shelf shifts. Leave upper wall space.
The bookcase swings inward to reveal a dark workshop. Ada stands beside Alex. Leave upper doorway space.

items.speaker: ADA
items.text: That’s one way to hide a room.
